Messages.Author: The Cadaverous Verger
Messages.Body:
As everyone has probably noticed by now, there's a TBA vampire on the
checklist. Personally I would have expected Huitzi advanced in the set,
him being the biggest, baddest Baali of 'em all, but this doesn't seem
to be the case, given that the TBA Baali is alphabetically after
Maureen. Or maybe the sneaky WW people have just mixed up the order a
bit to keep us guessing?

One possibility would of course be Shaitan. Although him as a separate
vamp would mean that Huitzi isn't really Shaitan. :)

Or, well, there's always the chance that it isn't a Baali at all, but
this doesn't seem very probable.

(As a side note, there seem to be five (or maybe just four, we'll see)
new Baali in the set. Might this fact be used to make the assumption
that the grouping rule will change to allow eg. group 2 and 4 vampires
in the same crypt?)

--CV

Messages.Author: Rogar
Messages.Body:
I think it was geo...@for.auth.gr <geo...@for.auth.gr>, who once wrote:
> > > The new Baali (Maureen) is G4, so no chances to see G3 bloodline
> > > members.
> >
> > Barbaro is group 3.
>
> Yeah, but barbaro is not a KMW set vampire, i was talking
> about KMW vampires...

I think LSJ's comment about groups being 'full' doesn't preclude group 3
vampires in KMW. He just said that any clan that received group 4 vampires
in a set, will *thereafter* not see more lower grouped ones. Like in the
Gehenna expansion, where some clans like the Gangrel Antitribu got both
group 3 and group 4 vampires, the Baali could get group 3 and 4 vampires
in KMW.

However, considering that bloodlines are supposed to support other
vampires, and not work on their own, and considering that in the Bloodlines
set, 5 Baali was apparently enough, I think the new vampires will be
group 4, with Barbaro in the middle to join either set. The rest of the
starter will be support vampires of various clans.

And the TBA vampire will be Rogar, a super powerful 13-cap. ;)

Rogar
